description: This PHP class defines the Wishlist model for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, providing methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count wishlist entries for customers.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: Model class for handling customer wishlists, including adding, deleting, retrieving, and counting wishlist entries.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Adds a product to a customer's wishlist by inserting a record into the database after removing any existing entry for the same product.

methods.name: deleteWishlists
methods.description: Deletes wishlist records for a customer, optionally filtering by product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves all wishlist entries for a given customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Returns the total count of wishlist entries for a customer.
